_comment: ADR-037 register fragment for openspec/changes/gateway-declared-data-feeds. `endpoint.feed` holds the dataset an app declared in its lib/Settings/feeds.json; FeedDeclarationService writes it with targetType `feed`, and EndpointService answers such an endpoint through FeedRequestHandler (GET only, declared fields, paging). `consumer.feedScopes` binds a consumer, per declaring app, to the scope values it may read (for shillinq: administration ids); a consumer without a binding for an app is refused on every feed of that app (REQ-DDF-003). No version bump: other fragments set these schemas' versions later in file order, and the import's content-differs path picks the new properties up.

feed.title: Data feed
feed.description: Set by the feed declaration sync: the declared dataset this endpoint serves. Edit the declaring app's feeds.json, not this value.

feedScopes.title: Feed scopes
feedScopes.description: Per declaring app, the scope values this consumer may read through that app's data feeds, e.g. {"shillinq": ["<administration id>"]}. Without an entry for an app every feed of that app answers 403.
